qa_pairs.question: Which component is listed under section 12 32 Governor?
What section of the manual covers Engine Electrical Equipment?
How many different screw sizes are specified for the regulator switch?
qa_pairs.answer: Two different screw sizes: M4 and M5

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M4 and M5 screws for the regulator switch?
qa_pairs.answer: 2 Nm difference (M4 is 2 Nm, M5 is 4 Nm)
